title: Aureline M5 stable go/no-go widening-decision record
description: Canonical per-domain record for the explicit stable go/no-go decision on a claimed launch-bearing widening event — an alpha, beta, release-candidate, stable, long-term-support, or correction-reissue widening. Names the decision kind (`packet_kind`) and preserves the final go/no-go decision (`final_decision_reference`), the open risks (`open_risks_reference`), the narrowed claims (`narrowed_claims_reference`), the named on-call and signoff roster (`on_call_roster_reference`, `signoff_roster_reference`), the exact evidence snapshot (`evidence_snapshot_reference`), and the decision-freshness expiry (`decision_freshness_reference`) that justified widening, so every claimed widening event resolves to one durable, reconstructible record rather than tribal memory and stable/LTS promotion halts automatically when the record is stale. Downstream shiproom, correction-line, release-center, docs/public-proof, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's widening decision by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
